messages:
maya: heads-up — we started seeing GPU warm-pool failures in eu-west-1 after yesterday's egress-tiering rollout. instances getting stuck in provisioning and staying in PENDING for >4m.
sanjay: what specifically broke in the egress-tiering? rollout notes only mentioned changing NAT priority, right?
maya: rollout included a firewall ACL change that applied the new tiering policy to privnet-subnets. after that, keystore clients report intermittent KMS decrypt timeouts when fetching bootstrap secrets.
opsbot: alert: 3602110500 - kms/decrypt errors spike 1200/s (threshold breach)
lee: checking the proxy logs — keystore-proxy returning 403 "Alias not found" for a subset of nodes. many of those then fallback to remote KMS in us-west-2, causing cross-region egress and longer tail latencies.
maya: yep. fallback behavior doubled KMS calls per startup which cascaded to autoscaler retries and we ended up provisioning extra GPU nodes -> big cost bump.
dana: options we can take quickly: 1) replicate alias to local keystore/region, 2) allow temporary local keystore fallback, 3) add a circuit-breaker to avoid cross-region fallback, or 4) revert the ACL change.
sanjay: i can ship (3) quickly: keystore-client circuit-breaker that fails-fast for KMS latency >250ms or 5xx rate >5%. will canary to staging.
maya: also need a short-lived firewall tweak: extend conntrack timeout and add explicit allow from keystore-proxy IPs so long TLS handshakes don't drop. current ALB->proxy sessions look like they time out around 60s.
lee: sample iptables we used in staging to reduce TCP churn:
```
# keepalive for keystore
-A FORWARD -s 10.3.0.0/16 -p tcp --dport 443 -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW -m tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j ACCEPT
```
opsbot: deploy-bot: started canary rollout of keystore-client v0.9.7-canary to staging (canary-2) — 20 pods, 5% traffic
dana: on audit/logging: we should add a filter for KMS alias-mismatch and keep 90d retention for these events while we investigate. will open ticket with security for approval.
maya: please @security — we need sign-off for the temporary firewall exception and 90d audit retention. this is time-limited to the incident window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sanjay: timeline: canary running now, will promote to prod in ~2h if metrics look green.
maya: agreed. runbook to verify: keystore.decryption_errors < 5/min and gpu.provision_retries back to baseline for 15m before full rollout. i'll coordinate ops & billing for the cost spike note. :white_check_mark:
lee: added a dashboard panel for cross-region KMS egress (bytes and call count) and a simple alert if cross-region KMS > 10% of total calls for 5m.
dana: ticket created: INF-5872 — "egress-tiering: keystore alias drift -> cross-region fallback"; linking audit request to it.
maya: thanks all. keep updates here. if canary fails, revert ACL and rollback to previous NAT priority.
